texts.preamble: Ram Sevak Sabha vs District Magistrate District Nainital ... on 2 September, 2015 Author: Alok Singh Bench: Alok Singh, Servesh Kumar Gupta In The High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital Writ Petition (Pil) No.133 of 2014 Ram Sevak Sabha ... Petiti Versus District Magistrate, District Nainital & others ... Respondents
texts.facts: Present petition is filed assailing the order dated 1.9.2014 passed by the Collector/District Ram Sevak Sabha vs District Magistrate District Nainital ... on 2 September, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156267338/ 1 Magistrate, Nainital. Petitioner is further seeking writ of mandamus commanding the respondents not to obstruct the animal sacrifice in light of the permission granted on 30.8.2014 by the Medical Health Officer, Municipal Board, Nainital. Undisputedly, Writ Petition (PIL) bearing Nos.73 of 2010 and 77 of 2010 were disposed of by the Division Bench of this Court vide judgment dated 19.12.2011. Feeling aggrieved, the present petition has been preferred. It is true that vide order dated 30.8.2014, the Medical Health Officer, Municipal Board, Nainital, has permitted the Temple Committee to establish temporary slaughter house on the bank of Naini Lake. Since, the judgment passed by the Division Bench of this Court on 19.12.2011 has not been challenged, therefore, the same has attained finality.
texts.arguments: Thus, the argument advanced by Mr. Sharad Sharma, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, that during Naina Devi Festival, animals will be sacrificed for the purpose of consumption of devotees in the slaughter house in and around Naini Lake, does not hold water for want of 'No Objection Certificate' or 'Licence' under the Regulations of 2011.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Thus, the argument advanced by Mr. Sharad Sharma, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, that during Naina Devi Festival, animals will be sacrificed for the purpose of consumption of devotees in the slaughter house in and around Naini Lake, does not hold water for want of 'No Objection Certificate' or 'Licence' under the Regulations of 2011.
